## 2024-05-24 - Missing Security Headers in SSR Configuration
**Vulnerability:** The Angular SSR Express server (`server.ts`) lacked essential security headers (like `X-Content-Type-Options`, `X-Frame-Options`, `X-XSS-Protection`, `Strict-Transport-Security`) and was leaking the `x-powered-by` header.
**Learning:** Default Angular SSR Express templates do not include security headers out-of-the-box. Any deployment using this as a production server needs a custom middleware to enforce secure HTTP headers.
**Prevention:** Always verify and harden Express configurations generated by framework boilerplates, ensuring standard security headers are added via middleware and information-leaking headers are disabled.
